scope: 2023 fall weekday cap85 and cap24 duty proxies; TransLink fixed-route service; double-deck and community shuttles only
evidence_cutoff_policy: Every parameter is labelled as known by 2023, derived from 2023, or later. Later product and procurement evidence is never backdated.
scenario_method: Planned range = nominal battery x usable fraction / winter kWh-per-km. Duty certainty requires the distance upper bound to be at or below range; a lower bound above range is a certain shortfall. Charging minutes use vehicle charge power x 0.90 efficiency.

double_deck_2033.overnight_only: Fails for the whole 57-block population in every screened scenario. Certain feasible / interval / certain shortfall counts are 33/2/22 at 472 kWh, 35/5/17 at 700 kWh and 43/6/8 at 827 kWh.
double_deck_2033.charge_requirement: The fitted range must be complemented by 150-300 kW DC charging or equivalent opportunity charging at terminals. A 2023 150-kW vehicle cannot replicate the 450-kW/5-15-minute strategy published for older 40/60-ft planning without longer dwell or more energy stops.
double_deck_2033.decision_time_view: As of 2023, the 472-kWh Enviro500EV specification and a North American prototype existed, but no Vancouver electric deck fleet or winter/payload certification was public. TransLink's later 2024 plan explicitly says to begin deck transition after 2030.

community_shuttle_2033.overnight_only: Certain feasible / interval / certain shortfall counts are 46/2/53 at 118 kWh, 51/1/49 at 150 kWh and 74/7/20 at 260 kWh. These are all stricter than a claim that most 2023 small-shuttle products cover the day.
community_shuttle_2033.capacity: The 2023 Endera 16+2 layout is short of the 20-space operating limit and can require about 11% more departures/vehicles. The 2025 30-ft Letenda trial has 44-person maximum capacity; it can restore capacity but still needs narrow-street and turning-radius verification.
community_shuttle_2033.decision_time_view: In 2023, small electric shuttle products existed, but the Calgary order for 14 vehicles later failed to deliver and was cancelled. TransLink's 2024 operator plan says community shuttles are not currently feasible for most blocks and should begin in the mid-2030s.

cost_judgment.additivity_warning: These class envelopes are not additive to results/vancouver_transition_scenarios.json. Removing shared depot/charger allocations from the non-deck baseline is required before combining them.
cost_judgment.price_basis_warning: The scenarios mix nominal 2020/2021/2023/2024 evidence and explicit FX/uncertainty assumptions. They are budgets, not bids, invoices or present values.
